# VoiceController voice commands

Everything you can say, by section. Each command has several forms and **all of them work**: the most natural one comes first. If you changed your commands in `commands.json`, say "help" and the program shows yours, the ones that work where you are.

- The basics
- The board and the green dot
- Clicking
- The window you work in
- Selecting
- Copy, paste and edit
- Files
- Keys
- Scrolling
- Dictating
- Formulas
- Programs and folders
- In Kate (text editor)

## The basics

They work at any time. If the passphrase is on, say it at start-up: it is your voice that is recognised, not the words.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`help`** | `ayuda`, `socorro`, `que puedo decir` | this very window: what you can say here |
| **`help audio`** | `ayuda audio`, `ayuda con audio`, `ayuda en voz alta`, `léeme la ayuda` | the help, also read out loud |
| **`raise`** | `subir`, `sube` | brings the VoiceController window to the front |
| **`monitor`** | `estado`, `muestra el estado`, `panel` | opens or closes the status panel (service mode only) |
| **`standby`** | `duerme`, `en espera`, `pausa` | stops listening until you say your passphrase. It also goes into standby by itself after a while unused |
| **`it's me`** | `soy yo`, `desbloquear`, `continuar`, `sigue`, `unlock`, `continue` | if it doesn't recognise your voice or it locked itself after a stranger's voice: asks for your passphrase again |
| **`local mic`** | `micrófono local`, `mic local` | back to the computer's microphone (after using the phone's) |
| **`código de emparejamiento`** | `código del móvil`, `emparejar móvil`, `empareja móvil` | says the code to pair the phone with this computer |
| **`close`** | `cerrar`, `exit`, `cierra` | closes VoiceController |

## The board and the green dot

The board splits the screen into 100 numbered squares. Inside a square, the zoom or the focus view, the green dot marks where the action will happen, and it moves with the directions.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`board`** | `tablero`, `casillas`, `números`, `rejilla`, `grid` | back to the board with the numbered squares |
| **`<a number from 1 to 100>`** | `<un número del 1 al 100>` | goes into that square of the board |
| **`move`** | `mover`, `mueve` | 'move &lt;square 1-100&gt;': zooms into that quarter of the desktop to aim |
| **`zoom out`** | `menos zoom` | from a square: shows the quarter of the screen around it |
| **`<direction> <number>`** | `<dirección> <número>` | inside a square, zoom or focus: moves the green dot that many pixels: "left 5", "northeast 3" |
| **`touch`** | `táctil`, `cara`, `face` | touch: the green dot follows the mouse or touchpad; face: it stops following it |
| **`refresh`** | `refrescar`, `refresca`, `refresco` | re-captures the screen and updates the view you are looking at |

Inside a square, the zoom or the focus view, they move the green dot one step:

| Direction | Also works |
|---|---|
| **`left`** | `oeste`, `izquierda`, `west` |
| **`right`** | `este`, `derecha`, `east` |
| **`up`** | `norte`, `arriba`, `north` |
| **`down`** | `sur`, `abajo`, `south` |
| **`northeast`** | `noreste`, `nordeste`, `ne` |
| **`northwest`** | `noroeste`, `nw` |
| **`southeast`** | `sureste`, `sudeste`, `se` |
| **`southwest`** | `suroeste`, `sudoeste`, `sw` |

## Clicking

With a square, the zoom or the focus view open, the action happens where the green dot is.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`click`** | `clica`, `clic`, `click izquierdo`, `left click`, `pulsa`, `pulsar`, `toca`, `pincha` | 'click &lt;square&gt;' or just 'click' with a square already chosen |
| **`right click`** | `click derecho`, `clic derecho`, `pulsa derecho`, `toca derecho`, `pincha derecho` | right click, same format as 'click' |
| **`double click`** | `doble click`, `doble clic`, `doble pulsa`, `pulsa dos veces`, `doble toca` | double click, same format as 'click' |
| **`scroll up`** | `scroll arriba` | scrolls up inside the square you're aiming at |
| **`scroll down`** | `scroll abajo` | scrolls down inside the square you're aiming at |
| **`scroll left`** | `scroll izquierda` | scrolls left inside the square you're aiming at |
| **`scroll right`** | `scroll derecha` | scrolls right inside the square you're aiming at |
| **`<a number from 1 to 9>`** | `<un número del 1 al 9>` | inside a square: acts on that detected zone |
| **`<action> <square>`** | `<acción> <casilla>` | in one go, at the centre of that square: "click 45", "double click 12" |
| **`<action> green`** | `<acción> verde` | acts where the green dot you move with the mouse or touchpad is: "click green" |
| **`<action> red`** | `<acción> rojo` | acts where the phone has its red dot: "click red". With the phone connected, the action alone is enough |

## The window you work in

The focus view shows the window you were working in, to act on it. The other commands act on the window in front.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`focus`** | `foco`, `enfoca`, `enfocar`, `ventana activa` | shows the window you were working on |
| **`focus <name>`** | `foco <nombre>` | the focus view, on that program's window: "focus kate" |
| **`trae <nombre>`** |  | brings that program's window to the front, said in Spanish for now: "trae kate", "trae explorador". NOT the same as "focus", which is the view |
| **`minimize`** | `minimiza`, `minimizar`, `esconde ventana` | minimises the window in front |
| **`maximize`** | `maximiza`, `maximizar`, `agranda ventana` | maximises the window in front |
| **`restaura`** | `restaurar` | unmaximises the window in front |
| **`fullscreen`** | `pantalla completa` | full screen (toggles) |
| **`close the window`** | `cierra ventana`, `cerrar la ventana`, `cierra la ventana`, `cierra esta ventana`, `cerrar esta ventana` | closes the window in front |
| **`siempre encima`** | `encima de todo` | keeps the window in front on top (toggles) |
| **`alt tab`** | `cambia ventana`, `cambiar ventana` | Alt+Tab |
| **`next tab`** | `siguiente pestaña`, `pestaña siguiente` | Ctrl+Tab |
| **`previous tab`** | `pestaña anterior` | Ctrl+Shift+Tab |
| **`close window`** | `cerrar ventana`, `cierra la pestaña`, `cerrar pestaña`, `cierra pestaña` | Ctrl+W: closes the tab or document |
| **`quit`** | `salir` | Alt+F4: closes the program in front |

## Selecting

Mark where it starts, take the green dot to where it ends, and say how to finish: as text or as an area.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`select`** | `seleccionar`, `selecciona`, `empieza selección`, `origen de selección`, `origen selección`, `selección`, `seleccionar aquí`, `marca aquí` | sets WHERE the selection starts (the dot turns yellow); for graphic areas, on empty space |
| **`end of selection`** | `fin de la selección`, `fin de selección`, `fin selección`, `termina selección`, `hasta aquí` | selects from the start point to here (text and lists) |
| **`select área`** | `arrastra aquí`, `arrastra hasta aquí`, `suelta aquí`, `drag here`, `seleccionar área`, `selecciona área`, `seleccionar el área`, `fin de área` | selects the area from the start point to here (icons, drawings) — the START must be on empty space |
| **`cancel selection`** | `cancela selección`, `cancelar selección`, `olvida selección` | forgets the start point |
| **`select all`** | `seleccionar todo`, `todo`, `selecciona todo` | Ctrl+A |

## Scrolling

"scroll" moves five lines; with "one" at the end, just one, which is handy for going through a menu. "again" repeats the last scroll, whichever it was.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`scroll up`** | `scroll arriba`, `desplazar arriba`, `sube página`, `desplaza arriba` | scrolls the view up |
| **`scroll down`** | `scroll abajo`, `desplazar abajo`, `baja página`, `desplaza abajo` | scrolls the view down |
| **`scroll left`** | `scroll izquierda`, `desplazar izquierda`, `desplaza izquierda`, `desplaza a la izquierda`, `desplaza la izquierda` | scrolls the view left |
| **`scroll right`** | `scroll derecha`, `desplazar derecha`, `desplaza derecha`, `desplaza a la derecha`, `desplaza la derecha` | scrolls the view right |
| **`scroll up one`** | `desplaza arriba una`, `desplazar arriba una`, `desplaza arriba uno`, `desplazar arriba uno` | a single line up: one by one through a menu. Also with a square selected |
| **`scroll down one`** | `desplaza abajo una`, `desplazar abajo una`, `desplaza abajo uno`, `desplazar abajo uno` | a single line down: one by one through a menu. Also with a square selected |
| **`scroll left one`** | `desplaza izquierda una`, `desplazar izquierda una`, `desplaza a la izquierda una`, `desplaza la izquierda una`, `desplaza izquierda uno`, `desplaza a la izquierda uno` | a single step left: one by one through a menu. Also with a square selected |
| **`scroll right one`** | `desplaza derecha una`, `desplazar derecha una`, `desplaza a la derecha una`, `desplaza la derecha una`, `desplaza derecha uno`, `desplaza a la derecha uno` | a single step right: one by one through a menu. Also with a square selected |
| **`again`** | `otra`, `otro`, `otra vez` | repeats the last scroll, whichever it was and in the same place |

## Dictating

"type" starts it: from then on, what you say goes whole into the Pre-Text, as a sentence. Speak normally: question and exclamation marks are added for you, and numbers come out as digits. If it gets it wrong, "question", "exclamation", "statement" or "math" redo the last sentence. While dictating, only the commands below work, said after a pause.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`type`** | `dictar`, `dicta` | switches to typing mode (writing text by voice) |
| **`enter`** | `entra`, `okey`, `ok`, `yes` | confirms what you dictated and writes it into the target app |
| **`reset`** | `borra`, `erase`, `borrar` | clears the Pre-Text and starts over |
| **`correct`** | `corrige`, `corregir`, `fix` | corrects a word: 'correct &lt;no.&gt; &lt;capital/initials/digits...&gt;' |
| **`correct <number> <how>`** | `corrige <número> <cómo>` | changes that word of the Pre-Text: capital, lowercase, acronym, digits or letters |
| **`question`** | `interrogación` | the last sentence, as a question: ...? |
| **`exclamation`** | `exclamación` | the last sentence, as an exclamation: ...! |
| **`statement`** | `afirmación` | the last sentence, with no question or exclamation mark: a full stop |
| **`math`** | `matemática` | the last sentence, as a formula (like "math" mode) |
| **`vale`** |  | accepts the suggestion shown below |
| **`listen`** | `idle`, `escucha`, `oye` | back to listening mode without confirming |

## Formulas

Formula mode writes symbols instead of words. It ends like dictation, with "enter" or "listen".

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`math`** | `deletrear`, `formule`, `fórmula`, `matemática`, `deletrea` | formula/maths mode, letter by letter |

| `greater than or equal to` | `>=` |
| `less than or equal to` | `<=` |
| `greater or equal than` | `>=` |
| `less or equal than` | `<=` |
| `is not equal to` | `!=` |

| `close parenthesis` | `)` |
| `open bracket` | `(` |
| `close bracket` | `)` |
| `open square bracket` | `[` |
| `close square bracket` | `]` |

| `close brackets` | `]` |

| `per cent` | `%` |

| `new line` | `P/n>>` |

Letters are said by their name: **a**: a; **b**: bee, b; **c**: c; **d**: dee, d; **e**: e; **f**: ef, f; **g**: gee, g; **h**: aitch, h; **i**: i; **j**: jay, j; **k**: kay, k; **l**: el, l; **m**: em, m; **n**: en, n; **o**: o; **p**: pee, p; **q**: cue, queue, q; **r**: ar, r; **s**: ess, s; **t**: tee, t; **u**: u; **v**: vee, v; **w**: w; **x**: ex, eks, x; **y**: y; **z**: zed, zee, z.

Pseudocode words: `if` → `-->`, `then` → `THEN`, `else` → `! -->`, `otherwise` → `! -->`, `while` → `WHILE`, `for` → `FOR`, `function` → `F#`, `result` → `F<<`, `return` → `>>>`, `returns` → `>>>`, `receives` → `<<<`, `takes` → `<<<`, `print` → `P>>`, `variable` → `VAR`, `do` → `DO`, `repeat` → `2X`, `integer` → `INT`, `float` → `FLOAT`, `boolean` → `BOOL`, `binary` → `BOOL`, `and` → `AND`, `or` → `OR`, `brackets` → `[`, `braces` → `{`, `parenthesis` → `(`, `true` → `True`, `false` → `False`, `not` → `!`.

## Programs and folders

Folders are the ones in your profile (Documents, Downloads...). A folder that doesn't exist is never created by asking for it.

| Say | Also works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **`terminal`** | `consola`, `konsole` | opens a terminal (on Windows it opens `cmd`) |
| **`explorar`** |  | file/folder browser (on Windows it opens `explorer`) |
| **`editor`** | `editar`, `texto`, `edita` | opens the text editor (on Windows it opens `notepad`) |
| **`firefox`** | `navegar`, `web`, `navega` | opens the web browser |
| **`inkscape`** | `dibujar`, `dibujo`, `dibuja` | opens Inkscape, the drawing program |
| **`carpeta <nombre>`** |  | brings that profile folder if open, or opens it; won't create it. Said in Spanish for now: "carpeta descargas" |
| **`terminal en <nombre>`** |  | opens a terminal inside that folder. Said in Spanish for now: "terminal en documentos" |
| **`crear carpeta <nombre>`** |  | creates a folder WHERE Dolphin is showing. Said in Spanish for now |
| **`crear archivo <nombre>`** |  | creates a file where Dolphin is showing, saying the extension by name at the end. Said in Spanish for now: "crear archivo apuntes texto" -&gt; apuntes.txt |
